translations.name: North Porch Women & Infants' Centers
translations.description: North Porch Women & Infants' Centers give baby supplies to families. You need a referral, but it can be a phone call from a social service agency, WIC or a local clergy member. You can visit every 2 months (6 times a year). Call 973-970-5215 for an appointment. Jersey City hours are Tuesday and Thursday 10am-1:30pm.
translations.website_description: Learn how to get diapers and baby supplies.
